Rank the Countries or Places Respondents Named

Source: R/route_analysis.R
ck_route_rank.Rd

The share of respondents in a unit who named each value in at least one slot. Counted directly rather than through one-hot columns, which on a full 4Mi round would mean a column for every place in every country.

Usage

ck_route_rank(id, unit, value, variable, w, groups, base_id = NULL)

Arguments

id

The respondent of each slot.

unit

The unit each slot is ranked within ("Overall", or the country).

value

The country or place the slot names; NA is left out of both numerator and denominator.

variable

The variable name to report.

w

Respondent weights.

groups

Named list of respondent-level disaggregation values.

base_id

The respondents of the denominator, for a ranking with a single unit ("Overall"); NULL (the default) for those who named at least one value. The full sample passes every respondent, so those who named nothing, or only None or Refused, stay in the base.

Value

Rows in the shape of ck_route_analyse().
